QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Signal Flare Necessities
QuestInfo.0: If the others are going to have any hope of finding you, you need to fire off a signal flare to let them know where you are. There's nothing you can use to start a fire, but it's far too dangerous to wander blindly around the area...
QuestInfo.1: If you tie a rope to yourself, you'll be able to find your way back to your starting point...
QuestInfo.2: You set up a signal flare, but the flare did no good. It's like the darkness just swallowed up the light. To make matters worse, when one of the soldiers finally did return, he was out of breath and panicking. What is going on?
